title: Justify or retire INV-01, INV-03, INV-07, INV-08 - four invariants with no decision record
description: Invariants are the load-bearing constraints and are stated as fact, but no ADR derives these four. INV-01 (one Magento instance for 10-20 websites at feed scale) is an untested capacity bet. INV-08 (cost > CWV > maintenance > time-to-launch) silently arbitrates every future trade-off. CLAUDE.md says never invent a decision; these were asserted in the skeleton commit, not decided. Either write the ADRs or downgrade them from invariants.

title: Decide ADR-0005 - catalog data layer
description: Last blocking ADR. Constraints already fixed by ADR-0006 and ADR-0007 are recorded in the ADR itself.

title: Confirm or reject the first market and vertical
description: market-selection.md recommends the Netherlands and a segment of hand tools / workshop consumables. Confirm against the two verification tasks, then record the choice.

title: Pull and inspect a real sample feed from a named NL-warehoused distributor
description: Produces three answers at once: identifier quality (open in ADR-0006), SKU count and cadence and delta-vs-snapshot (inputs to ADR-0005), and evidence the goods are already placed on the EU market (INV-10).

title: Keyword-level organic competition analysis, Dutch, 2-3 candidate segments
description: market-selection.md names this as the one criterion (MC-04) it could not settle from public sources. Need search volume, top-10 domain strength, and whether bol.com and the incumbent DIY chains hold the head terms.

title: Verify beads sync round-trips from a fresh clone
description: bd dolt push reported success but nothing has been pulled back on a second machine or clone. Until that is tested, the durability of the queue is assumed, not known.

title: Resolve the three beads-vs-harness collisions
description: bd prime forbids TodoWrite/TaskCreate for task tracking, forbids MEMORY.md in favour of bd remember, and ships its own session-close protocol that overlaps CONVENTIONS.md. Each needs a call: adopt, reject, or scope. Leaving them unresolved means two sets of rules.

title: Verify the version claims in c4-container.md against primary sources
description: OpenSearch 2.19+, Valkey 8 / Redis 7.2, Varnish 7.6/7.7, PHP 8.4, and 'Elasticsearch removed in Magento 2.4.8' are stated as fact and none was verified. CONVENTIONS requires explicit versions; explicit and wrong is worse than vague.

title: Fill 10-architecture/api-contracts/ - the two supplier contracts first
description: The adapter contract must carry ADR-0007 labelling evidence as feed fields, not as paperwork.

title: Decide returns policy
description: Commercial decision. Blocks the returns design (VC-17) and the ReturnRequest entity, still TBD in domain-model.md. No warehouse, so routing differs per supplier.

title: Write domain model transition tables
description: Allowed actors, guard conditions, event emitted per transition, for every state machine in domain-model.md.

title: Decide reservation strategy - cart, checkout, or PO acknowledgement
description: The main oversell lever. Carried as OPEN in domain-model.md. Needs SC-06 (oversell threshold) set first. Interacts with the winning-offer rule left OPEN in ADR-0006.

title: Strengthen the sourcing behind market-selection.md market figures
description: Allegro's share came back as 30%, 45-50%, and 60% across secondary aggregators; the doc uses 'reaches over 80% of Polish online shoppers'. bol.com and NL market-size figures are likewise from aggregators, not primary reports. The regulatory citations are solid; the market figures are the soft spot if the recommendation is challenged.

title: Version-control the workspace-root Claude wiring
description: .claude/settings.json (SessionStart hook) and the session-close skill symlink live at the workspace root, which is not a git repo. Losing that directory silently disables both. Options: git init at the root with docs as a submodule, or a short runbook to rebuild it.
